description:
Planning only; implementation requires an explicit user instruction. The current handoff in parent zaq-h2i.3 is authoritative for this task and supersedes older proposed shapes and historical implementation comments. Verify live source/Git before acting; historical green logs do not validate this checkout. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/code-quality.md and applicable service guides. Read DESIGN.md and docs/bo-components.md before UI work. Follow docs/testing-approach.md; existing test behavior changes require explicit approval.

Contract prerequisite: maintain the approved envelope and file_delivery.limits extension specified in the parent. Reuse the existing capability_snapshot/1 callback and CommunicationBridge.normalize_capability_snapshot/2. No file_delivery_capabilities callback or parallel source API without proven adapter contract necessity. Inspect actual Mattermost/Jido/Web APIs and compatible versions; resolve configured-value versus provider-ceiling ambiguity explicitly. Bridge translation supplies only declared facts; shared normalization and FileSettings retain their established ownership. Required applies only for usable file support. No support-status changes invented to show settings. Preserve data-source isolation, selected identity and disabled-configuration inspection. Source-contract gaps are owned with zaq-h2i.4; the exact adapter extension must be agreed before dependent implementation. Historical completion/approval notes refer to prior revisions, not blanket approval for new test behavior or coding.

comments.text: Additional discovered API prerequisite: selected disabled connections cannot use current config_id capability lookup because Bridge.fetch_scoped_capability_config/2 requires enabled:true. Propose an additive configuration-inspection scope on the existing :channel_capability_snapshot request, preserving default runtime lookup semantics and provider/kind/archive checks, or justify provider-scope static metadata where no selected-specific transport facts exist. Concrete consumer: editing a disabled selected BO/SMTP connection. No new endpoint or secret projection. Exact source and scope must be agreed with the metadata contract before implementation.

User instructed continue after the concrete contract proposal. Proceed with the additive metadata extension, shared configuration contract and pure resolver. Preserve current support statuses/raw snapshots, dependency pins, issue 1 and all existing test behavior. Locked adapters without the optional metadata callback remain unavailable/unresolved; no provider-specific inference or ignored dependency edits. Configuration validation may remain incomplete while file sending is unsupported, but required configuration is enforced for supported file delivery and by the resolver. This preserves existing SMTP saves while explicitly marking values required for future file delivery.

Original TDD red confirmed: new capability projection/configuration-scope tests fail on missing file_delivery metadata and disabled-scope lookup; normalization/resolver tests fail for undefined new modules/APIs. Result: 2 properties and 7 tests failed, with 3 checks passed and 126 excluded by the focused API describe selector. Log /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-red.log. Dependency compilation and isolated test database preparation succeeded. New component/SMTP/persistence tests are written and will receive their own red run before wiring implementation. Existing tests remain untouched.

Implementation and issue-level checks complete for this step: final mix q passes; combined original/new regression passes 522 checks (6 properties/516 tests). See parent zaq-h2i.3 for original TDD red/green logs, unchanged test evidence, unresolved adapter metadata follow-up, intermittent existing WebKit E2E failure and remaining UX/coverage/precommit/review gates. Keep in progress until review/landing; no code commit/push authorized.

Completed the approved callback-reuse/ownership correction. Removed file_delivery_capabilities/1 entirely from Bridge, EmailBridge and JidoChatBridge, including generic callback declaration/optional callback entry and file-specific generic helpers. Generic Bridge now contains no file-delivery-specific references; it delegates communication snapshot enrichment by kind. CommunicationBridge.normalize_capability_snapshot/2 owns metadata validation/projection. SMTP returns its existing configuration metadata through capability_snapshot/1. JidoChatBridge matches HEAD/stack base byte-for-byte; current adapter declarations/status matrix and all original Jido tests remain unchanged.

Explicit data-source guards cover FileSettings metadata/support/visibility/validation and selected connections in TransportRequirementsResolver. Existing normalized communication API/UI behavior and configuration policy semantics are preserved. Shared BO fixtures use the existing snapshot response instead of an alternate callback.

TDD: seven original expected red failures before production changes. Focused green passed 163 checks; final broad regression passed 598 checks (6 properties, 592 tests), 179 excluded by the focused Jido selector. Final mix q passed formatting, hooks.verify, strict Credo with no issues, docs and compilation. git diff --check passed. The only changed pre-existing assertion is the specifically approved raw SMTP exact-snapshot assertion; text/thread statuses remain identical and IMAP/unrelated assertions remain intact. Issue 1 source/test hashes still af19ee7478d9b00faf8fbd4b1f8bff984db8eba87fbea736bcb86ff936ee16f3 and fef42b887f2b6293c6bef7bc9b9a12d87b2458b714711e7f81c359b47cbda913.

Current service docs and Beadwork contract/follow-up descriptions now describe existing snapshot reuse and communication ownership; no future task should reintroduce the removed callback or put structured data into Jido's support-status matrix. No new feature E2E authored. No repeat full E2E for this ownership refactor with equivalent user-visible communication behavior; negative data-source scope is covered by unit/component/domain tests. Prior full-browser WebKit navigation blocker zaq-yx7.5, UX approval zaq-h2i.3.4 and consolidated E2E zaq-h2i.3.5 remain open, as do adapter metadata follow-up zaq-h2i.4 and post-review coverage/final gate. No mix precommit, code commit, push, staging or PR publication. Logs /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-reuse-{red,green,q,regression}.log.
